references.text: The washing of the entrails and legs is prescribed in the instructions for the burnt offering, where it states that the priest shall wash the entrails and legs with water.
The same procedure of washing the entrails and legs, as well as burning them on the altar, is described for the burnt offering of small livestock.
The entrails and legs are also mentioned in connection with the sin offering, where the same parts of the animal are treated.
At the consecration of Aaron and his sons, Moses performed the same action of washing the entrails and legs and burning them on the altar.
In the instructions for the daily burnt offering in Exodus, the washing of the entrails and legs before they are burned on the altar is also mentioned.
